name: Platinum agents
author: Jude Gomila
message: Editing pass: every TL;DR and summary stands alone

fields.before: "Cisplatin and carboplatin crosslink DNA. Curative in testicular cancer and central to lung, ovarian, bladder, head and neck, and TNBC treatment."
fields.after: "Platinum agents such as cisplatin and carboplatin work by crosslinking DNA. They are curative in testicular cancer and central to lung, ovarian, bladder, head and neck, and TNBC treatment."
